fields.description: Prefilled with the translated DocType label when the DocType is selected (freely editable) and used on the first file upload to find or create a document type of the same name.
fields.label: Paperless Document Type Name

fields.description: Optional. The link field holding the party that becomes the correspondent. Examples: "customer" on "Sales Order"; "party_name" on "Quotation" (a dynamic link: whether it is a Customer, Lead, ... comes from "quotation_to"). The party is the linked master record and its title field is transferred as the correspondent name. The input only suggests matching link fields. Used to resolve a document-specific correspondent via the correspondent mapping instead of the global default. Leave empty if this DocType has no suitable party.
fields.label: Party Fieldname

fields.description: Determined automatically: whether a correspondent renamed directly in Paperless NGX can be written back to the display name of the party master record linked here (see correspondent_sync.can_rename_via_title_field()).
fields.label: Rename Supported

fields.description: Filled automatically on the first file upload for this DocType, as soon as the corresponding document type has been found or created.
fields.label: Paperless Document Type ID
